d:
Bihar MLC Result : bihar MLC chunav 2026 ke natijon ke bad bailet pepar ko lekar siyasat garma gaee hai. kangres ke chunavi pradarshan par pradhanmantri narendr modi ne tanj kasa, vahin BJP aur JDU ne bhi kangres par nishana sadha. virodhiyon ka kahna hai ki bailet pepar se chunav hone ke bavjud kangres ko apekshit saphalta nahin mili.
Dusri or, RJD ne kuchh siton par kathit pharji voting aur prashasnik dabav ke aarop lagae hain. kangres ne bhi BJP par palatvar kiya hai. aise men saval uthta hai ki bihar MLC chunav ke natijon ne bailet pepar ko naya rajnitik mudda kaise bana diya?
